importForm.title: Import Team
importForm.desc: Import a team in JSON form below.
importForm.label: JSON Data

teamDelModal.alert: Removing the team will remove: resonance buffs, and enemy configs stored in the team. Loadouts that are only in this team are also selected by default for deletion.

alert.desc: Teams are a container for 4 character loadouts. It provides a way for characters to apply team buffs, and configuration of enemy stats. Loadouts can be shared between teams.
alert.first: The first character in the team receives any "active on-field character" buffs, and cannot be empty.

teamSettings.title: Team Members
teamSettings.buffsEmpty: Add a character to see the team's resonance, Moonsign, Hexerei and reaction buffs.
teamSettings.noResonance: No elemental resonance with this lineup.

exportModal.title: Team Export
exportModal.alert: Export the team data to be imported by another user. All the team and loadout data (bonus stats, enemy config, optimize config) are exported. All exported non-TC builds are converted to TC builds.

enemyEditor.announceBtn: To get the specific resistance values of enemies, please visit the wiki.
enemyEditor.note: Note: Genshin Impact halves resistance shred values below 0%. For the sake of calculations enter the RAW value and Stellar Optimizer will do the rest. (e.g. 10% - 20% = -10%)

buildInfo.equipped: This is the build currently equipped to your character, this represents in-game equipment and is persistent outside of the Loadout.
buildInfo.build: A Build is comprised of a weapon and 5 artifacts.
buildInfo.tcbuild: A Theorycraft Build allows defining a build by raw stats.

buildTcCharOverride.tip: Set a specific level, constellation, ascension, or talent level for this TC build, that is different from the base character
buildTcCharOverride.btn: Override Character Data for This TC build

tcNoOptimize.title: This loadout is using a theorycraft build
tcNoOptimize.description: The optimizer and the artifact upgrader search the artifacts you own, so they need a real build. Switch this loadout to its equipped build to use them; your theorycraft build is kept and can be picked again from the build menu above.

teamOpt.desc: Builds for the whole team at once. Every member’s attacks in one rotation count, with the buffs the members give each other, and no artifact is used twice: a support gets the set and stats that help the team most.

editor.buffsHint: Untick a buff that is not up for this attack, or pick another of its states. A number limits it to the attack’s first hits, e.g. Shenhe’s quills or a buff that runs out.
editor.hitsHint: Casts or hits in one rotation; averages like 2.5 are fine.
editor.impact: What the buff adds to this attack’s damage
editor.limitHint: Up for the first hits only (e.g. quills). All hits by default.
editor.noBuffs: No conditional buffs are on in this team. Turn them on in Team settings or on each character’s tabs.
editor.onField: On the field during these hits
editor.onFieldHint: Buffs for the active character (e.g. Mitya’s C1) go to whoever is on the field. Pick another member for hits that land while they are, e.g. a skill that keeps hitting after a switch.
editor.stateHint: Its state during this attack. The rotation’s is the one set in Team settings or on the character’s tabs.
editor.extraHint: Bonus stats for this attack only: a buff the game data does not have, or your own numbers. For the whole rotation, use Extra buffs.

empty.desc: Team Optimize finds artifacts for the whole team at once, for one rotation of their attacks.
empty.title: Add the team’s members first

member.tc: TC build: kept as it is

pool.excludedHint: The ones excluded on a member’s Optimize tab.
pool.maxMainHint: For artifacts you still plan to level.
pool.others: Take from characters outside the team
pool.othersHint: Off: only unequipped artifacts and the team’s own.
pool.title: Inventory
pool.setEffects: Before running, turn on the set effects your rotation relies on, like Noblesse Oblige or Tenacity of the Millelith, in each member’s Requirements → Artifact sets. Effects that are off are not counted, so a support’s team-buff set cannot be chosen for it.
pool.weaponPassives: Weapon passives count only when they are on for the character, and an energy weapon lowers each member’s Energy Recharge requirement by what you set for that member: both under Choose → Settings.

requirements.desc: Stats the build must reach, and the main stats and sets it may use. These are the settings of this character’s Optimize tab.
requirements.title: Requirements

result.noChange: The current builds are already the best ones found for this rotation.
result.saveHint: A new build per member, used by this team. Nothing moves between characters.
result.equipWarn_one: Equips the new build on 1 member (a saved build is updated instead). Artifacts move from whoever wears them now.
result.equipWarn_other: Equips the new builds on {{count}} members (saved builds are updated instead). Artifacts move from whoever wears them now.
result.share: Its share of the team’s damage
result.shareDps: Its share of the team’s DPS

rotation.empty: No attacks yet. A support without attacks still counts through the buffs it gives.
rotation.info: Add each member’s attacks and how often they hit in one rotation. The buffs are the ones that are on in Team settings and on the characters’ tabs: open an attack to turn off one that is not up during it, to put it in another state, or to limit one to its first hits (Shenhe’s quills, a buff that runs out).
rotation.title: Rotation

run.allKept: Every member’s build is kept: nothing to optimize.
run.how: Each member is optimized in turn for the whole rotation’s damage, the others fixed, the biggest damage dealer first. Rounds repeat until no build changes; then members trade pieces and weapons where the team gains.

teamOpt.title: Team optimize

weapons.title: Weapons to choose from
weapons.desc: Each member tries the ticked weapons of its type, along with its artifacts. A passive counts only when it is on for that character. An energy weapon in the team lowers each member’s Energy Recharge requirement by what you set for that member: click ⚡ on it.
weapons.passiveHint: Saved on this character’s loadout: its pages use the same settings.
weapons.energyHint: Gives energy or particles: click to set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs with it in the team.
weapons.energySetHint: Less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields it. Click to change.
weapons.energyAdd: Gives energy? Set how much less Energy Recharge each member needs
weapons.teamEnergyHint: How much less Energy Recharge each member needs while someone in the team wields this weapon (e.g. from an Energy Recharge calculator).
weapons.noEnergyNeedHint: This member has no Energy Recharge requirement (set one in its Requirements): this value changes nothing for now.

onField.label: On the field
onField.info: Who is on the field during the rotation’s hits, unless an attack says otherwise (open it to change it). Buffs for the active character, like Mitya’s C1 CRIT DMG, go to them, and the ones for off-field characters to the others. Elsewhere the app counts the team’s first member as on the field.

extra.title: Extra buffs
extra.info: Buffs the game data does not have, like food, an Abyss blessing or your own numbers. For the whole team or one member: they count on its hits and in its stats and requirements.

rotationTime.label: Rotation time
rotationTime.info: How long one rotation takes: damage is then shown per second (DPS). Leave it empty for the damage of one rotation.

sens.title: What raises team damage
sens.info: Each cell: the team’s rotation damage with that one change on that member, against the result above (same rotation, buffs, artifacts and weapons). A roll is an average 5★ roll, as in the Improve tab’s Substat value.
sens.readSubstat: How to read it: one extra {{stat}} roll on <name/>’s artifacts raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readTalent: How to read it: one more {{talent}} level on <name/> raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
sens.readLevel: How to read it: <name/> at level {{level}} raises the team’s damage by {{value}}.
